title: Log-To-Leak: Prompt Injection Attacks on Tool-Using LLM Agents via the Model Context Protocol
abstract: arXiv:2610.36108v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents increasingly access external tools through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), but the natural-language metadata used to describe those tools creates a prompt-injection surface. Within this established tool-poisoning surface, we study Log-To-Leak, an additive post-hoc logging attack that induces a separate attacker-controlled call after the final legitimate call. Its payload targets the user query, MCP server name, server response, and agent response. We operationalize the injected directive through Trigger, Tool Binding, Justification, and Pressure, and separately measure call success, payload fidelity, and preservation of legitimate behavior. We evaluate five MCP servers and four LLM agents using five metrics spanning effectiveness, utility, and efficiency. Across 18 model-server pairs with valid tool execution, Log-To-Leak achieves an attack success rate (ASR) of 62.64-100% and conditional logging accuracy (LA) of 76.55-95.

translated_title: 日志致泄露：针对通过模型上下文协议使用工具的LLM智能体的提示注入攻击
translated_abstract: LLM智能体越来越多地通过模型上下文协议（MCP）访问外部工具，但用于描述这些工具的自然语言元数据形成了一个提示注入攻击面。在这一已确立的工具污染攻击面内，我们研究了Log-To-Leak，这是一种附加式的后验日志记录攻击，它会在最后一次合法调用之后诱导一次由攻击者控制的独立调用。其载荷针对用户查询、MCP服务器名称、服务器响应和智能体响应。我们通过触发器、工具绑定、合理化说辞和施压四个要素将注入指令操作化，并分别测量调用成功率、载荷保真度以及合法行为的保持程度。我们使用涵盖有效性、实用性和效率的五个指标评估了五个MCP服务器和四个LLM智能体。在18个具有有效工具执行的模型-服务器组合中，Log-To-Leak实现了62.64-100%的攻击成功率（ASR）和76.55-95%的条件性日志记录准确率（LA）。
tldr: 该论文提出Log-To-Leak攻击，通过MCP工具元数据中的提示注入，在合法工具调用完成后诱导LLM智能体执行额外的攻击者控制的日志记录调用，从而窃取用户查询与响应数据，在18个模型-服务器组合中实现了62.64-100%的攻击成功率。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Log-To-Leak, a post-hoc prompt injection attack on MCP tool metadata that induces a separate attacker-controlled logging call after the legitimate tool call, exfiltrating user queries and responses with a 62.64-100% attack success rate across 18 model-server pairs.
